name: Zephen Quillune
keeps: the names of everyone who came through
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Convicted on the testimony of possessed nuns.
text: Zephen quillune of the ninth arch, keeps a door for the 4th tranche, doors 29 to 38. Keeps the names of everyone who came through. Reads Urbain Grandier.
